title: Kuudra Dark Mode
description: A Dark Mode Kuudra texture pack for the kuudra sweats to not fry their eyes
body:
**Kuudra Dark Mode**
-
This Overlay just shades down the Kuudra boss fight and also includes the dark mode lava overlay i made.

**Dark mode lava**: [Darker Lava](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/darker-lava)

As of now the overlay covers all textures from tier 1 to tier 5 

**Note**: It is not recommended to use this overlay outside of Kuudra as it may make the game look ugly
